name: veterinaria-api
description: API REST para la gestión de una veterinaria

scripts.postman:run: npm run postman:prepare && newman run postman/Veterinaria-API.postman_collection.json -e postman/Veterinaria-API.local.postman_environment.json --reporters cli,junit --reporter-junit-export reports/newman-results.xml
scripts.postman:run:ci: npm run postman:prepare && newman run postman/Veterinaria-API.postman_collection.json -e postman/Veterinaria-API.local.postman_environment.json --bail --reporters cli,junit --reporter-junit-export reports/newman-results.xml
